sources.title: Censo Demografico 2022 - Tabela 9514: Populacao residente, por sexo, idade e forma de declaracao da idade
sources.snapshotRule: freeze exported file and record SHA-256
sources.validation: FAIL_CLOSED: ages 0..99 plus 100+ required; no overlap; age sum must equal declared Total

sources.publisher: Secretaria Municipal da Saude de Sao Paulo / CEInfo
sources.selection: residentes no Municipio de Sao Paulo, independentemente do municipio de ocorrencia
sources.snapshotRule: freeze publication snapshot; preliminary and final are distinct provenance
sources.validation: FAIL_CLOSED: residence required; invalid/out-of-period dates rejected; overlapping periods rejected; duplicate hashes rejected; snapshotDate >= periodEnd and <= current date

notes: Generate once from frozen official exports; commit generated JSON and regenerated manifest with SHA-256.
SIDRA 9514 is the age-stock source; conversion from age to daily birth date is a declared Jornada model.
SINASC supplies the observed post-Census segment for residents of Municipio de Sao Paulo; do not substitute occurrence geography.
Preliminary SINASC data may change until final publication and therefore must carry snapshot date/hash.
SIDRA 9514 publishes simple ages through 99 and the open category 100 anos ou mais; internal 100+ allocation is modelling, not an IBGE observation.
No remote source is consulted by the synthetic generator at runtime.
